description: Source code for transformers and code transformation utilities used in challenge building, including Babel transpilation, SASS processing, and HTML embedding.

classes.name: WorkerExecutor
classes.description: Class for executing worker tasks, such as SASS compilation.

methods.name: loadBabel
methods.description: Dynamically imports Babel standalone and registers loop protection plugins.

methods.name: babelTransformCode
methods.description: Returns a function that transforms code using Babel with specified options.

methods.name: getBabelOptions
methods.description: Generates Babel options based on presets and loop protection settings.

methods.name: transformSASS
methods.description: Transforms <style> tags with SCSS syntax into CSS using a worker executor.

methods.name: transformScript
methods.description: Transforms inline <script> tags with Babel, optionally adding module support.

methods.name: embedFilesInHtml
methods.description: Embeds challenge files into HTML content, transforming scripts and styles as needed.

methods.name: challengeFilesToObject
methods.description: Converts challenge files array into an object keyed by file type.

methods.name: parseAndTransform
methods.description: Parses HTML string into DOM and applies a transformation function.

methods.name: getHtmlTranspiler
methods.description: Creates a function to transpile HTML files with SASS and script transformations.
